tool.description: ReconcileSource performs one reconcile pass over a source: the host operation the declared schedule's occurrences admit, and the same work a person asks for by hand. It resolves nothing with the provider itself — GitHub gets a conditional reconcile that snapshots only if its head moved, and a pull provider the full sync its connector has — so an occurrence is never slowed by one unreachable source.
tool.name: ReconcileSource
